sourcePolicy: No guessing. Exact Dimli/Fleck source files are linked. Gog exact card text remains unavailable and is bridged only by an explicit project-rule override.

matchingCardNames: I got this from playing in the Town Square.

facts: Cards that pay with Gold from the Inn are allowed even for Gold payments caused by a card the payer played themselves.
Official team example shows a payment owed to another player being paid with Gold from the Inn instead; the original recipient remains the recipient.

Merchant Ship explicitly treats four Gold as four separate payment instances; a pay-from-Inn card replaces one such payment instance. This establishes that the response attaches to a payment instance rather than globally to all future losses.
A current official Sometimes card in the same mechanic family triggers when the player would lose Gold and substitutes Inn Gold for the player's own Stash.
The official generic wording is not limited to ante only.

specialCases.paymentToInn: Payer's stash does not decrease; destination remains the Inn, so abstract Inn balance has no net change.
specialCases.ante: Inn supplies the Gold to the gambling pot.
specialCases.paymentToPlayer: Inn supplies the Gold to the original recipient player.
specialCases.goldTakenByPlayer: Inn supplies the Gold to the player who would have taken it.

exclusions: Does not override an effect that explicitly forbids avoidance/substitution/payment from the Inn.
Does not apply to future independent payment contexts; each separate payment/loss is evaluated separately.
Does not change the recipient/destination or convert a payment into a gain for the payer.

gog.mechanicFamily: Pay or Ante with found gold

projectRuleOverride.rule: Gog's two M09 cards use the exact same normalized M09 semantics as the verified Dimli/Fleck mechanic family, with no extra card-specific restrictions.
projectRuleOverride.mustNotClaim: Do not label Gog's exact wording or absence of extra printed restrictions as official-source-verified.
